facts.claim: Real companies have failed through the same mechanisms: negative unit economics, customer concentration, dependence on supplier-financed float, and loss of a credit facility after covenant breaches.
facts.framing: Stated as a general pattern without naming any company; viewers are pointed to the three questions rather than to specific firms.
facts.notes: Kept generic on purpose. Naming a real company would require dated primary sources (court filings, 10-Ks) and status 'verified'.
